name: advanced-table
title: Advanced Table
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A stateful data table with search, typed sorting, pagination, row selection and batch actions — composed, so your data keeps its own shape.

files.content:
"use client";

/**
 * Compatibility shim: the data table lives in TableBlock. Only its components
 * and types are forwarded — the hooks and helpers are in `./table-core`, so
 * this file stays one that exports components and nothing else.
 */
export {
  DataTable,
  DataTableBatchAction,
  DataTableBatchBar,
  DataTableBody,
  DataTableCell,
  DataTableContent,
  DataTableEmpty,
  DataTableExpandToggle,
  DataTableExpandedRow,
  DataTableExport,
  DataTableFilter,
  DataTableFooter,
  DataTableHead,
  DataTableHeader,
  DataTableHeading,
  DataTableInfo,
  DataTablePageSize,
  DataTablePagination,
  DataTableReset,
  DataTableRow,
  DataTableSearch,
  DataTableSelect,
  DataTableSelectAll,
  DataTableTabs,
  DataTableToolbar,
  Table,
  TableAction,
  TableBadge,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableContent,
  TableEmpty,
  TableExpandToggle,
  TableExpandedRow,
  TableFooter,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableHeading,
  TablePerson,
  TableRow,
  TableRowAction,
  TableRowActions,
} from "./TableBlock";

export type {
  DataTableBatchActionProps,
  DataTableBatchBarProps,
  DataTableBodyProps,
  DataTableExpandedRowProps,
  DataTableExportProps,
  DataTableFilterOption,
  DataTableFilterProps,
  DataTableHeadProps,
  DataTablePageSizeProps,
  DataTableProps,
  DataTableRowProps,
  DataTableSearchProps,
  DataTableTab,
  DataTableTabsProps,
  TableActionProps,
  TableAlign,
  TableBadgeProps,
  TableBadgeTone,
  TableBodyProps,
  TableCellProps,
  TableColor,
  TableEmptyProps,
  TableExpandToggleProps,
  TableExpandedRowProps,
  TableHeadProps,
  TableHeadingProps,
  TablePersonProps,
  TableProps,
  TableRowActionProps,
  TableRowActionsProps,
  TableRowProps,
} from "./TableBlock";

docs: Named exports: DataTable plus DataTableHeading/Content/Header/Body/Row/Head/Cell/Footer/Empty, DataTableSearch, DataTablePageSize, DataTableSelect, DataTableSelectAll, DataTableBatchBar, DataTableInfo, DataTablePagination, DataTableExpandToggle, DataTableExpandedRow, DataTableTabs, DataTableFilter, DataTableReset, DataTableBatchAction, TableAction, TableRowAction, TableBadge, TablePerson, useDataTable, resolveAccessor. `DataTableTabs` and `DataTableFilter` filter one field each by exact match (`by` is a dot path or accessor); `useDataTable` exposes `filters`, `isFiltered` and `resetAll`. `variant="soft"` gives the admin-dashboard look. `DataTableBody` takes a render function receiving the current page of rows. `getRowId` defaults to id → _id → uuid; `sortBy` accepts a dot path or an accessor function (add `sortId` for functions). Builds on `table` and depends on `select` for the page-size control.
